messages:
Laura (Docs): quick PR incoming to clarify tiered rate headers and add three tiny SDK snippets + a promql for the usage panel. will open in ~30m.

Olivia (DevEx): thanks — include a one-liner pointing to Console -> Usage analytics -> Per-route.

Kevin (Eng): prod headers are X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining and X-Redwood-Quota-Window; keep X-Quota-* as fallback. tiny express snippet: app.use((req,res,next)=>{const r=res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')||res.getHeader('X-Quota-Remaining');req.quota=Number(r||0);next()})

Michael (Billing): on downgrades, phrase as: "typically a short (~7 day) grace period; enterprise agreements may differ" and link billing playbook. add a reconciliation hint to use billing exports + redwood_tokens_consumed_total.

Laura (Docs): added that language and a promql example: sum by(customer_tier)(increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total{env="prod",customer_type!~"internal|test"}[7d])) 

DocsBot: Reminder: PR template requires changelog entry and billing-playbook crosslink.

Laura (Docs): will include changelog + migration note. tagging reviewers on PR. :+1:
